words.prose: {{ar:أَلَا}} ({{tr:ʾalā}}) opens the ayah by fusing alert, question, and negation into a rebuke. Its force reaches over {{ar:يَظُنُّ}} ({{tr:yaẓunnu}}) and the resurrection proposition that follows, so the issue is not merely that a belief is denied, but that expected reckoning is culpably absent. Coming after the measuring scene in 83:1-3, the first word turns public commercial behavior into an interrogation of the mental premise behind it. Its initial catch and fused shape also make the rebuke audible from the first syllable, before the cognition verb tightens the question.

topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the main clause as a rhetorical question, and the particle stands before {{ar:يَظُنُّ}} ({{tr:yaẓunnu}}), so the CRITICAL claims about rebuking negative scope are locally licensed.

topics.reason: The surface form supports the fused interrogative-negative reading, and the local rhetorical-question analysis gives the sound observations a real syntactic target.

words.prose: {{ar:يَظُنُّ}} ({{tr:yaẓunnu}}) is the hinge of the ayah: the rebuke targets a present act of reckoning that should hold the whole proposition {{ar:أَنَّهُمْ مَّبْعُوثُونَ}} ({{tr:ʾannahum mabʿūthūna}}). The imperfect keeps the failure live rather than past, and the postverbal demonstrative subject ties that failure to the exposed group. The root range allows supposition, expectation, and stronger contextual conviction, but the market setting narrows the local payoff to practical reckoning: people skilled in calculating measures fail to calculate being raised into their conduct. Positive expectation passages such as 2:46 and 69:20 sharpen the contrast, while the local pairing with {{ar:مَّبْعُوثُونَ}} ({{tr:mabʿūthūna}}) compresses cognition and resurrection into one question. The held ending of {{ar:يَظُنُّ}} ({{tr:yaẓunnu}}) gives that failed reckoning audible pressure before the clause lands on the raised status.

topics.reason: The attachment data force {{ar:أَنَّهُمْ مَّبْعُوثُونَ}} ({{tr:ʾannahum mabʿūthūna}}) as the clausal complement of {{ar:يَظُنُّ}} ({{tr:yaẓunnu}}), preserving the CRITICAL thought-content claims.

topics.headline: imperfect aspect makes non-reckoning present and culpable

topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the form as an imperfect active cognition verb under rebuking interrogation, with {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ʾulāʾika}}) as its explicit subject.

topics.reason: V4 confirms a broad {{ar:ظ ن ن}} ({{tr:ẓ-n-n}}) field, including certainty, supposition, suspicion, and expected-place senses; local grammar and context keep the selected value to practical reckoning with the resurrection proposition.

words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّهُم}} ({{tr:ʾannahum}}) turns the question inward. The particle packages what follows as the content of {{ar:يَظُنُّ}} ({{tr:yaẓunnu}}), while the attached {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) makes the content concern the same group just pointed out by {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ʾulāʾika}}). That pronoun is not a direct object of the verb; it is the internal subject of the complement, whose predicate is {{ar:مَّبْعُوثُونَ}} ({{tr:mabʿūthūna}}). The compact fusion avoids restarting the deixis and audibly carries the group into the doubled mīm of the raised predicate.

words.prose: {{ar:مَّبْعُوثُونَ}} ({{tr:mabʿūthūna}}) is the ayah’s closing weight. As a passive participial predicate of {{ar:أَنَّهُمْ}} ({{tr:ʾannahum}}), it names the same group as recipients of raising rather than actors in control, and it leaves the raiser unexpressed. The word does not close on an abstract resurrection noun or on a separate event report; it gives the accused a settled raised status inside the thought-content. The root field can evoke rousing, dispatching, and raising the dead, but the local passive predicate narrows that field to being raised or sent forth into accountability. That reverses the agency of 83:3: those who actively caused loss are now described as acted upon. The final placement delays the resurrection word until the question lands, and it points forward to the great day named next in 83:5. Its passive raised wording also belongs to a wider questioned-or-denied resurrection formula, specialized here as a final nominal status. Sound also contributes: the mīm from {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) presses into the doubled mīm of {{ar:مَّبْعُوثُونَ}} ({{tr:mabʿūthūna}}), binding the group to its fate.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word removes their control: they are not raisers or self-movers, but the ones upon whom raising is enacted.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as a passive participle and predicate, with passive agency unexpressed, so the CRITICAL recipient-status claims are directly licensed.

topics.headline: the predicate completes the thought as status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes on their described raised status inside the thought-content, not on an abstract event noun or a separate narrated action.
topics.reason: The word is the nominative masculine plural predicate of the {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:ʾanna}}) clause, completing the content governed by {{ar:يَظُنُّ}} ({{tr:yaẓunnu}}).

topics.headline: the root field narrows to accountable raising
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root image of being roused or dispatched into presence, while local grammar keeps the selected sense to passive resurrection-accountability.
topics.reason: V4 confirms accepted {{ar:ب ع ث}} ({{tr:b-ʿ-th}}) branches for rousing, dispatching, and raising the dead, but the local passive participial predicate selects the resurrection/accountability branch rather than every branch at once.

topics.headline: active loss-making becomes passive raising
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary reversal from agents who caused loss in 83:3 to recipients upon whom resurrection is enacted in 83:4.
topics.reason: The local passive predicate supports the reversal against the prior active conduct described in the CRITICAL boundary rows.

topics.headline: the final word delays and opens the accountability horizon

topics.reason: The predicate appears last inside the complement, and the CRITICAL rows provide the concrete next-ayah anchor in 83:5.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The demanded “supposition” is already evidential certainty.** `ظ ن ن` B001 is certainty after an indication, whereas B003 is uncertain supposition. The interrogative challenge, followed by the great day and human standing (83:5–6), keeps both branches active. I assign B003 to their practiced uncertainty and B001 to the minimum conclusion the visible moral asymmetry should support. The abductive move is that the transaction itself is an indication from which accountability can be inferred. The ayah reads as an accusation that even their alleged uncertainty is epistemically evasive.

2. **Resurrection as forced motion out of settled practice.** `ب ع ث` B001 supplies rousing a still thing into motion. The habitual `إِذَا` pattern in 83:2–3 depicts a stable routine; 83:6 then depicts people rising. I infer that being “sent forth” interrupts not only bodily stillness but a social arrangement treated as permanent. The ayah reads as the prospect of an entrenched system being forcibly mobilized into review.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The demonstrative `هَٰذَا` in 83:17 and the return of acts in 83:36 turned resurrection from a remote proposition into an evidential encounter, sharpening `ظ ن ن` B001 over mere speculation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A failure to let indication mature into certainty.** Lexical evidence: ظ ن ن/B003, "suspicion or uncertain supposition," and B001, "certainty after an indication," in يَظُنُّ. Structural cue: 83:2-3 supplies a repeated, observable asymmetry; 83:6 supplies collective standing; 83:7-9 supplies a written, marked record. Assigned role: B003 names their weak mental stance, while B001 names the epistemic strength that accumulated indications should produce. Abductive move: I infer that the question rebukes failure to upgrade evidence into settled expectation; the packet gives the two branches and evidence sequence. Reading change: يَظُنُّ is not merely a minimal request that they "think"; it diagnoses chosen uncertainty in the face of signs capable of certainty.

2. **Rousing breaks the stillness that enables repetition.** Lexical evidence: ب ع ث/B001, "rousing a still thing into motion," in مَّبْعُوثُونَ. Structural cue: the repeated إِذَا clauses of 83:2-3 depict a settled routine, while 83:6 turns that routine into bodily standing. Assigned role: rousing interrupts habitual moral and bodily inertia. Abductive move: I infer that transactional repetition is a kind of stillness because its agents no longer reassess it; the packet supplies repetition and later rising, not that psychological equation. Reading change: being raised reads as forced interruption of a normalized practice, not only movement from death to life.

3. **The dispatched party must reach a common forum.** Lexical evidence: ب ع ث/B002, "dispatching and directing someone," as a secondary activation in مَّبْعُوثُونَ. Structural cue: 83:6 gives the destination-like scene of all people standing before one authority, and 83:7-9 gives the record brought into that scene. Assigned role: B002 treats the raised agents as directed respondents rather than merely revived bodies. Abductive move: I infer destination and summons from the standing/record sequence; no explicit destination verb appears in the fixed ayah. Reading change: the passive participle acquires the force of being sent into accountability with one's transactions attached.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The marked book at 83:9 sharpened the secondary ب ع ث/B002 reading: those roused are not sent into an empty scene but toward a forum containing fixed evidence. It also corrected ظ ن ن/B003 by showing exactly what their cultivated uncertainty fails to anticipate.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Moral Boundary, Repair, and Returned Judgment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Conduct is measured by whether it preserves or crosses a moral limit, then returns to the actor as blame, repair, or recompense.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same cycle extends backward to delay before good and forward to confession, renunciation, and expiation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Imputation, Suspicion, and Confession
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Guilt is placed upon someone, entertained as an accusation, denied or admitted, and converted into accountable speech.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: loading sin onto another `ء ث م:B004/m01`; accusatory suspicion `ظ ن ن:B004/m01`; charging someone with falsehood `ك ذ ب:B002/m01`; confession and acknowledgment `ع ر ف:B009/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Imputation supplies the charge, suspicion supplies its uncertain social circulation, and confession reverses that uncertainty by making responsibility explicit.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Temporal Course, Occurrence, and Terminal Change
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Events occupy a bounded course with a beginning, recurrence, delay, approach, and completed outcome.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Ordinary duration expands into respite, cyclical passage, catastrophic occurrence, and resurrection.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Calamitous Event and Rising
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A severe occurrence arrives as the event of a day, rouses what was still, and brings a collective rising.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: the day's calamitous occurrence `ي و م:B003/m01`; an adverse state coming to pass `ك و ن:B006/m01`; bitter ordeal `م ر ر:B004/m01`; overwhelming calamity `ع ظ م:B004/m01`; resurrection and rising `ق و م:B013/m01`; rousing from stillness `ب ع ث:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Event, severity, and rising form one eschatological mechanism. The day is not a neutral date but an occurrence that breaks stasis, gathers bodies into standing, and fixes an adverse or saving outcome.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Linguistic operators locate a referent, join it to another term, open or correct discourse, and bind speakers to propositions.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Function words form scenes of pointing, questioning, oath-taking, correction, essence-definition, and even letter and rhyme construction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Definition, Essence, and Signification
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A thing is isolated as itself, assigned a limit or definition, and allowed to signify its condition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: essence or selfsame identity `ن ف س:B012/m01`; the thing itself `ع ي ن:B013/m01`; defining limit `ق و ل:B016/m01`; a thing's indicative “saying” `ق و ل:B014/m01`; locus where a quality is expected `ظ ن ن:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Identity supplies the referent, definition gives it a boundary, and signification lets its state communicate beyond explicit speech. The locus motif grounds abstract definition in where a property is expected to reside.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Social judgment is enacted through covert gesture, laughter, fault-finding, shame, and eventual reversal of who observes whom.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The scene extends from a private eyelid signal to public reputation, bodily expression, shamelessness, and returned humiliation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Covert Gesture and Fault-Finding
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Members of a group identify a target, signal one another covertly, and turn a suspected defect into shared ridicule.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: covert wink or hand signal `غ م ز:B002/m01`; locating a defect or point of attack `غ م ز:B003/m01`; accusatory suspicion `ظ ن ن:B004/m01`; visible effect of a disparaging look `ن ظ ر:B007/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The signal recruits an audience without open speech, suspicion supplies a fault, and the repeated look marks the target socially and visibly.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Knowledge depends on what can be seen, displayed, recognized, inferred, concealed, or watched.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Visual knowledge reaches into eye anatomy, reflected human images, dream, apparition, harmful gaze, espionage, divination, and omen-bearing birds.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Knowledge, Recognition, and Evidential Judgment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A trace is perceived, interpreted, and converted into recognition, knowledge, or warranted certainty.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: practical knowledge `د ر ي:B001/m01`; disclosed knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`; recognition from a trace `ع ر ف:B003/m01`; certainty following an indication `ظ ن ن:B001/m01`; informed testimony `ش ه د:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The trace initiates inference, recognition identifies the object, and testimony makes the resulting knowledge available to others. Certainty is the endpoint of interpreted evidence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Knowledge depends on what can be seen, displayed, recognized, inferred, concealed, or watched.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Visual knowledge reaches into eye anatomy, reflected human images, dream, apparition, harmful gaze, espionage, divination, and omen-bearing birds.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Suspicion, Divination, and Hidden Knowledge
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Uncertain signs are read by a specialist who claims access to concealed outcomes, sometimes through animal omens.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: doubt and conjecture `ظ ن ن:B003/m01`; untrustworthy outcome `ظ ن ن:B006/m01`; diviner claiming hidden knowledge `ع ر ف:B012/m01`; specialist or learned sage `ر ب ب:B003/m01`; raptor used within the omen field `ع ل م:B006/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Uncertainty creates demand for interpretation, the specialist claims to resolve it, and the raptor supplies a mobile sign whose behavior can be read as an omen.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Wild animals occupy habitats, move as predator or prey, emit identifying signals, and enter human hunting sequences.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The field joins ibex, hyena, wolf, raptor, ostrich, traps, stalking, animal cries, and collective scattering.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Flight, Dispersal, and Collective Motion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A flock or group erupts from stillness, scatters in multiple directions, and continues in rapid movement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ostrich flight and group dispersal `ن ع م:B008/m01`; collective rush `ب ع ث:B004/m01`; sudden outpouring `ف ج ر:B003/m01`; confused commotion `ب ل ل:B009/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Sudden activation breaks the group's prior cohesion, commotion obscures ordered direction, and dispersal turns one gathered body into many moving trajectories.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Motion is organized by activation, sending, route, succession, arrival, return, and control of a vehicle.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The movement field reaches from messenger and collective rush to paced travel, a small boat, and its captain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rousing, Dispatch, and Messenger
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A still agent is activated, given a direction, and sent as a messenger toward a task.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: rousing from stillness `ب ع ث:B001/m01`; commissioning and dispatch `ب ع ث:B002/m01`; sending forth `ر س ل:B001/m01`; messenger and message `ر س ل:B002/m01`; rising to undertake an affair `ق و م:B003/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Activation creates readiness, commissioning supplies purpose, and sending converts intention into directed movement carried by an identified messenger.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Motion is organized by activation, sending, route, succession, arrival, return, and control of a vehicle.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The movement field reaches from messenger and collective rush to paced travel, a small boat, and its captain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Collective Rush and Scattering
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A group is stirred into rapid motion, moves in waves, and may scatter under pressure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: collective surge `ب ع ث:B004/m01`; sudden outpouring `ف ج ر:B003/m01`; successive moving groups `ر س ل:B005/m01`; group dispersal `ن ع م:B008/m01`; mixed commotion `ب ل ل:B009/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Activation starts the surge, successive waves preserve some order, and scattering marks the point where collective motion exceeds coordination.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A person's ability to act is shaped by vigor, composure, fatigue, self-estimation, honor, and comfort.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Inner condition ranges from patient composure and alertness to helplessness, pride, conquest, bodily softness, and luminous well-being.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fatigue, Helplessness, and Diminished Agency
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Capacity declines through dullness, fatigue, weakness, or smallness until action stalls.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: blunt fatigue `ك ل ل:B001/m01`; helpless weakness `ظ ن ن:B008/m01`; stopping through weariness `ق و م:B016/m01`; slightness or paucity `ط ف ف:B001/m01`; slackened effort `ء ل ي:B008/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Slight capacity reduces force, fatigue blunts continuation, and helplessness turns a temporary pause into inability to complete the act.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.
